name: dsh-plugins
description: Monorepo root for the @dennisrongo dsh plugins. Not published — pnpm needs a manifest at the workspace root.
author: Dennis Rongo

scripts.test: node scripts/check-suites.mjs && node scripts/check-type-scale.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-progress.mjs && pnpm -r --if-present run test && node scripts/check-context.mjs
scripts.// check:suites: Every plugin must declare a test script that runs. `pnpm -r --if-present run test` SKIPS a package with no test script and still reports green, which is how dsh-skills shipped eleven releases with zero tests and nothing could tell you. Runs FIRST because it is the cheapest gate and a structurally missing suite makes every later result partial.
scripts.// check:type-scale: Every plugin's UI text must sit on the harness's 11/12/13/14/16/20/24 ladder. Each plugin ships its own inline CSS, so nothing structural keeps them together.
scripts.// check:tokens: Every var(--dsw-*) a plugin uses must be a token the harness defines. A misspelt name silently uses its fallback forever and stops following the theme.
scripts.// check:progress: Every loading state follows dsh-git's rule: a skeleton for a large pane, a dim caption row for a small one. The sweep animates background-position only (never a layout property), shares one timing, and flattens under prefers-reduced-motion. Each plugin copies the pattern behind its own prefix, so nothing structural keeps the copies together.
scripts.// probe:progress: Measures each skeleton against the REAL row it replaces in headless Chrome, and checks prefers-reduced-motion actually stops the sweep. NOT in `test` because it needs Chrome on the machine. It caught two silent bugs source-reading could not: skeleton rows 7-15px shorter than the rows they replace (the lurch the skeleton exists to prevent), and a reduced-motion rule outranked by a later equal-specificity rule in the same sheet.
scripts.// check:context: Every client plugin must mount on a REAL cordis context and serve its slots with only the services it declares. Runs LAST because it reads built lib/ output. A cordis context is a Proxy: reading an undeclared service throws, where a test stub returns undefined — so per-package smoke tests cannot see this class of bug.
scripts.// prepare: Point git at the versioned hooks. .git/hooks is not cloned, so without this a fresh clone silently has no pre-commit gate. Tolerates non-repo checkouts (tarball installs) rather than failing the install.
scripts.// postinstall: pnpm replaces profile links with frozen copies on every install. This re-runs the platform's dev-link (junctions on Windows, symlinks on macOS/Linux) right where the damage happens. Non-fatal — see scripts/dev-link.mjs.
